g.text: MessageDispatcher are all pub(crate) — invisible externally.
UdsHandler is pub — user implements it, library calls it.
Arc<ServerConfig> shared by all components at construction.
Server detects close via read() EOF.
No explicit disconnect API — tester owns initiation.
Server closes after T_TCP_Initial or T_TCP_General
timer fires with no response from tester.
T_TCP_Initial (2 s) or T_TCP_General (5 min)\ninactivity timer fires inside TcpConnection::run()
[initial inactivity — no routing activation before T_TCP_Initial]
[general inactivity — RoutingActive but no UDS traffic]
